component.name: Noor Notes
component.summary: Private, offline-first sticky notes for Linux

description.p: Noor Notes is a native Linux application for private, offline-first sticky notes.

Create richly formatted notes, organize them in a searchable library, and recover notes from Trash when needed. Noor Notes can import existing Xpad notes without changing the original files, and optional encrypted synchronization is available when configured.

screenshot.caption: Create and format a private sticky note.

description.p: Initial store release with offline notes, rich text editing, Xpad import, Trash recovery, and optional encrypted synchronization.
